content.text: All three look right. Final verification of exact pixel dimensions:

Done — three PNGs are in the folder, each at exactly the requested size:

| File | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | Logo + event name top-left, title block, speaker row (circle portrait beside name/role), date & venue, pill CTA |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | Two columns: content left (brand, title, meta, CTA), 420px circular portrait with name/role right |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | Centered stack: brand, 380px circular portrait, name/role, title, meta, CTA |

Built from `card.html` (one responsive source, `?v=square|landscape|story`), rendered with Playwright at CSS scale so no downsampling.

Details handled:
- **Inter** loaded via `@font-face` from `Inter.ttf` (variable weights 100–900); render waited on `document.fonts`, verified `document.fonts.check` returns true so nothing fell back to a system font.
- **Portrait stays circular** at every size — fixed square box with `border-radius:50%`, `object-fit:cover`, plus a violet accent ring.
- **Title wraps, never clipped** — 3 lines on square/landscape, 4 on story, with `text-wrap:balance` and a violet-highlighted phrase for emphasis.
- **No overflow or overlap** — I measured every element's bounding box against the card bounds; `scrollWidth/Height` equals the card size in all three, and content is distributed with flex spacers rather than fixed offsets.

Two defects found during checking and fixed: in landscape the speaker name was breaking mid-word into "Maya Okonkwo-/Lindqvist" (widened the side column to 520px, nudged the name to 42px, forced it onto one line), and both landscape and story had a large dead gap below the title (split the leftover space into two flex spacers so the blocks sit evenly).
